args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (error rate 18%, unhealthy in us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback verified: all regions now running v2.3.0. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were both healthy.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** (the most recent release that was healthy in production) in all regions. The rollback was verified — all regions are now on v2.3.0.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for `checkout-api` describing the failure and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer for follow-up on root cause.

Note: I did not deploy any new version, so no change-manager approval was needed — this was a rollback to a previously healthy production release.
